comparison.objective: Place a lintel across two free-standing posts without moving them, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Title implies long-object alignment and gentle bimanual placement; body, tolerances, and scoring are absent. Candidate requires precision tool use and dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Only the title establishes lintel placement and immobile posts; seating tolerance, post-motion limit, damage rules, and scoring are missing. Candidate has explicit dynamic criteria.
comparison.reason: Structural placement is clearly different from damper commissioning despite the incomplete rubric.
